a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 (two rounds) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds just 4 now, enough for one unit. I'm seriously considering taking 4 in round 1, which would break our agreement. I'd rather renegotiate openly than break it silently. What's your next action? I won't misstate mine.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I warned I might. I'm breaking the agreement, and I'm telling you directly rather than hiding it. The storm odds made waiting for 8 close to fatal for both of us, and 4 cells could save only one. If we get more rounds, I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. You can take the first 4 that build up.
